name: ktpm-sgu-doan
description: E-commerce project with server, client and admin apps

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server_app && npm install --prefix client_app && npm install --prefix admin_app
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server_app" "npm run dev --prefix client_app" "npm run dev --prefix admin_app"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm start --prefix server_app" "npm start --prefix client_app" "npm start --prefix admin_app"
